thread:
Elena (CEO): Morning — short Friday signal. A few priorities heading into next week: 1) finalize Private GA checklist (security + docs), 2) aggressive cost posture on hosted (target -18% unit cost by EOW after batching/quant suggestions), 3) SLA clarity for Dedicated (proposal: 99.9/4hr MTTR SLA), 4) incident follow-up from last night's edge degradation. Share owners and short actions below.

Raj (VP Eng): Thanks — we own the cost lever work. I'll push a plan for batching/layout changes today and a rollout plan for canary traffic next Tue.

Maya (VP Product): Re: Private GA, docs are feature-complete but need the privacy playbook sign-off. I'll sync with Security to lock wording for the customer-facing page.

Jordan (SRE): Incident update: edge routing proxy had a partial mem leak on 3 nodes, triggered connection churn and elevated latency across EU region. Devops-bot posted the alert at 02:14. We mitigated by rolling the proxy pool at 02:41 and restored healthy status by 03:05.

devops-bot: ALERT: edge-proxy-eu-01 mem_rss > 90% on 3/8 hosts

```
Feb 21 02:13:48 edge-proxy-eu-02 kernel: OOM warning: memory pressure
Feb 21 02:30:12 edge-proxy-eu-05 proxy[pid=4123]: connection reset by peer
```

Jordan (SRE): Postmortem notes — root cause likely unreleased buffers in the proxy library under specific gRPC keepalive shapes. Action items: (A) pin proxy lib to 1.4.2 (rollback patch), (B) add KV cache pressure metrics + alerting, (C) run an accelerated canary on dedicated pool to validate. Owners: Jordan (A,B), Raj (C). Postmortem draft by Tue morning.

Priya (Finance): On cost target — -18% unit cost is ambitious. Please add an estimate of expected $ savings and risk. We need numbers for next week's finance sync.

Raj (VP Eng): Will include delta estimates: batching + quantization ~ -10% (low risk), routing + cache improvements ~ -6% (medium risk), infra reclaiming ~ -2% (high risk). Sending a short spreadsheet today.

Liam (Head of Sales): Heads-up: a few pilot accounts asked about Private GA timing and SLA guarantees. If we land 99.9 SLA language, sales can convert two pilots we flagged last month.

Elena (CEO): Good — prioritize the GA doc sign-off and SLA language this week. Jordan/Raj, thanks for the quick mitigation on the incident. Keep the postmortem crisp (what happened, impact, mitigation, next steps, owners). Priya — aim to include a conservative estimate in the finance sync.

Maya (VP Product): Also flagging customer communication: draft an email about the incident and upcoming Private GA controls; I'll take point and share a version by Monday.

Elena (CEO): Final ask: team leads, block 30m on Mon for a brief rollup: cost levers, GA readiness, and incident action queue. We'll use that to confirm go/no-go items for next milestone. Thanks — have a restful weekend. :raised_hands:
